fusions.name: Kick Off the Bank
fusions.desc: Kicks out with both legs, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles and knocking them 3 tiles back. You move 30% faster for 3 seconds afterwards.

fusions.name: Snapping Tongue
fusions.desc: Snaps your tongue at a target up to 5 tiles away, which deals 4 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at full reach, with a 30% chance to leave it [Slowed] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Leap Clear
fusions.desc: Springs you 5 tiles forward, and you move 20% faster for 3 seconds after you land.

fusions.name: Coiled Haunches
fusions.desc: When your stamina is full, your physical damage rises by 30% for 3 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
